name: Ball Sort Puzzle
description: A relaxing color-sorting puzzle. Stack matching balls into the same tube.
overview: Ball Sort Puzzle is a casual brain-teaser: move balls between tubes until every tube holds a single color. It is built with libGDX and runs in the browser through GWT.
features: Tap-to-move controls for mouse and touch
Multiple background themes and ball skins
Runs in any modern browser, no install needed
benefits: Ready-to-extend puzzle engine with a clear level model
A good starting point for publishing a casual mobile game
Cross-platform libGDX setup for web, desktop, Android and iOS

includes: Gradle build for web, desktop, Android and iOS
Placeholder art so the project builds
excludes: Game name, logo and store listing

requirements.label: IDE
requirements.value: Android Studio or IntelliJ IDEA (iOS builds need a Mac with Xcode)
